nodes.name: Hub webhook
nodes.notes: The hub POSTs a line step here (adapter `n8n`, settings.workflow = line-callback-demo), signed with X-HQ-Signature. The raw body is kept: the signature is over the exact bytes.

nodes.name: Verify and sign
nodes.notes: Checks the hub's signature (HMAC-SHA256 over '<t>.<raw body>', at most 300 s old), does the rule work (here: only echoes), and signs the answer the same way. The secret is HQ_SIGNING_SECRET (the same as kv/hq/n8n). No model is called here.

nodes.name: Call back the hub
nodes.notes: POST /internal/v1/lines/callback on the api (internal network only; never through Caddy), signed. The engine finds the waiting step by `token` and finishes it.
